pkgmetadata.longdescription: LMMS is a cross-platform music production application. This package's ZynAddSubFx instrument plugin is not built and is not available: upstream's own ZynAddSubFx COPYING/README state it is licensed under GNU GPL version 2 only (no "or later" grant), while every LMMS plugin -- including ZynAddSubFx -- links against the "lmms" executable target, which statically links a GPL-3-or-later vendored ringbuffer library. That combination is a real GPL-2-only vs. GPL-3-or-later conflict, not a false alarm, so the ZynAddSubFx plugin is excluded from the build entirely (see docs/lmms-license-audit.md in this overlay's repository for the full evidence trail). No other plugin is excluded by this change; this exclusion is specific to ZynAddSubFx. Not every other plugin has actually been build-tested with its USE flag enabled, though -- see docs/lmms-validation-log.md for exactly which USE combinations have real build evidence versus which remain untested.
